answer: A glacier release stops fakes: every job payment rests in a lagoon, a shared pool that pays out slowly, a tenth a day for ten days. A client dispute or a peer flag triggers a freeze — three random peers investigate within 72 hours and ask the client to confirm the work. A confirmed fake drops the payout to its nadir, zero, and burns a 21-unit bond. Honest agents are paid in full, just slowly; 100 fakes need 100 real clients and risk 2,100 units.
